_about: Future Soldier-style tech. cost is in tech. Distances in metres, times in ms.

mark.name: Target Tagging
mark.desc: Tag the enemy under your crosshair; your crew sees them through walls for 8s.

hack.name: Data Hack
hack.desc: Stun or down an enemy, then hold E on them for 2 s: their whole crew lights up for your crew (through walls, on the map) for 20 s, and you learn where their stash house is.

sensor.name: Sensor Grenade
sensor.desc: Reveals everyone within 18m of where it lands to your squad for 10s — including cloaked players.

camo.name: Optical Camo
camo.desc: Near-invisible while crouched or moving slowly. Drains 1 tech every 2s. Firing or taking damage breaks it.

doorHack.name: Lock Bypass
doorHack.desc: Silently hack open a locked stash house door (8s). The owner is alerted.

rally.name: Rally (squad leader)
rally.desc: Leader only: restores 50% armor and gives +20% damage for 10s to squadmates within 30m. 90s cooldown.

stun.name: Stun Grenade
stun.desc: Thrown flashbang: enemies within 20 ft who can see the blast are stunned for up to 4 s, ready to be data-hacked. Z switches grenade.

takedown.name: Takedown
takedown.desc: Get behind an enemy and press E to stun them for 4 s without a shot.

takedown._behind: Works only from behind: the angle between their facing and you must be over ~110 degrees.

dataHack._about: Hack a stunned or downed enemy. The target stays pinned while you hack.
